_comment: This is the ONLY source of truth for blog content generation. The generation script must not invent facts, statistics, testimonials, or claims that are not present here or explicitly supplied by the owner. Add real facts (metrics, anecdotes, new projects) here as they become available.

pricing.paymentTerms: 50% of the agreed build fee to start, balance after review and approval before launch or file transfer. Annual domain/hosting charges are separate; optional care is billed monthly.
pricing.revisionPolicy: Two consolidated revision rounds within the agreed design and scope; additional rounds or scope changes are quoted separately.
pricing.deliveryCondition: Targets start after the 50% build deposit, complete content and required access are received. Feedback delays, scope changes and merchant/provider approvals can extend the schedule.
pricing.scopeBoundaries: Two consolidated revision rounds. Client supplies approved text, brand assets and licensed images. Copywriting, extra pages, extra product uploads, custom APIs, paid licences and larger revisions are separately quoted before work starts.
pricing.hosting: From KES 3,000/year; the first-year and renewal price are confirmed in writing.

extras.name: Copywriting, custom APIs and paid licences

services.name: Web Design & Development
services.description: Mobile-first, professionally designed websites, from a focused brochure site to a larger multi-page platform, built around what the business actually needs to do.

services.name: E-commerce & M-Pesa Stores
services.description: Full online stores with M-Pesa (Daraja API) checkout built in, product management, and inventory, so businesses can sell to customers who'll never walk into a shop.

services.name: SEO, GEO & AEO
services.description: Basic on-page SEO comes with every website. Also builds in GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation): structured data and FAQ schema that help a business get recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude, not just found on Google.

services.name: Domain Registration
services.description: Registers .co.ke, .com, .org, .ke, .africa and .io domains directly, from KES 1,500/year, with free WHOIS privacy and self-service DNS management. Pay via M-Pesa.

services.name: SaaS & Custom Platforms
services.description: Bespoke web applications, booking and reservation systems, marketplaces, and custom integrations for businesses that have outgrown a standard website.

services.name: Social Media Management
services.description: Monthly social media management packages so businesses can grow their brand with consistent, professional content, without hiring an in-house team. Covers Facebook, Instagram and TikTok content, reels/short videos, story posts, promotional graphics, and monthly reporting.

socialMediaManagement.tagline: Grow your brand with consistent, professional content.

individualDesigns.name: Individual designs
individualDesigns.description: Professional social media graphics for businesses that just need occasional designs, not a full monthly package.

portfolio.name: Irene Muendo Isuzu
portfolio.challenge: An Isuzu dealership with no online presence, relying entirely on showroom walk-ins.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: A model listings site with financing info and a WhatsApp inquiry button on every vehicle page.
portfolio.result: A professional site the dealership can now point buyers to before they ever visit the showroom.

portfolio.name: SMA Advocates
portfolio.challenge: A law firm winning clients only through in-person referrals, with no way to be found online.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: A professional site with practice areas, attorney bios, and an online inquiry form.
portfolio.result: A credible online presence that lets prospective clients research the firm before they call.

portfolio.name: Sage Beans Export
portfolio.challenge: A yellow bean exporter needing to reach international buyers who'd never heard of their Kajiado operation.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: Product detail pages, export quality standards, and a global partnership inquiry flow.
portfolio.result: A site that reads as export-ready to buyers evaluating suppliers from outside Kenya.

portfolio.name: Oncolink Kenya
portfolio.challenge: An oncology platform needing to be approachable to patients, not just professionals.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: A patient-friendly portal with clear service navigation and an appointment request flow.
portfolio.result: A site built for accessibility and ease of use on mobile, where most patients actually browse.

portfolio.name: Teria CBO
portfolio.challenge: A community-based organisation needing grassroots mobilization, donor transparency, and direct digital contributions.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: Mission-driven CBO portal with impact metrics, community outreach programs, and clear donor support flows.
portfolio.result: A high-trust platform that establishes donor accountability and grassroots legitimacy.

portfolio.name: Kenya Remote Jobs
portfolio.challenge: A high-traffic recruitment marketplace connecting Kenyan professionals with verified global remote work opportunities.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: High-speed job board platform with programmatic SEO, searchable job taxonomy, and automated M-Pesa subscription access.
portfolio.result: Massive organic search indexation and automated recurring monetization.

portfolio.name: Billan Beauty
portfolio.challenge: Cross-border logistical delays and dual-currency conversion friction between UK suppliers and Kenyan buyers.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: Dual-hub London and Nairobi storefront with dual-currency pricing (GBP/KES), batch authenticity seals, and rapid courier dispatch.
portfolio.result: Frictionless cross-border sales and enhanced customer trust with verified authenticity.

portfolio.name: Greenhunt Energy
portfolio.challenge: High-value solar equipment buyers needing transparent sizing calculators and EPRA accreditation proof.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: Commercial solar portal combining system sizing taxonomy, kilowatt calculators, EPRA badges, and direct M-Pesa hardware checkout.
portfolio.result: High customer confidence and streamlined procurement for commercial and residential clean energy.

portfolio.name: PataMaps
portfolio.challenge: Families with special needs children in Kenya struggled to find accredited, verified therapy clinics, inclusive schools, and NCPWD services.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: An accessibility-first directory compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA standards, multi-county provider locator, community review engine, and direct WhatsApp helpline integration.
portfolio.result: Empowered hundreds of caregivers across Nairobi, Kiambu, and nationwide to discover verified therapy clinics in minutes with zero guesswork.

portfolio.name: SAN Group Limited
portfolio.challenge: A multi-subsidiary infrastructure contractor bidding on large county and cross-border tenders with fragmented digital credibility.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: A high-authority corporate holding portal showcasing roads, bridges, WASH water systems, and heavy equipment chartering for public and private tender vetting.
portfolio.result: Established institutional credibility that enables enterprise procurement teams and government agencies to verify past projects and plant machinery fleet.

portfolio.name: Elite Designs Kenya
portfolio.challenge: A boutique brand consultancy needed a structured web presence to present standardized branding packages and pricing tiers to Nairobi businesses.
portfolio.whatWeBuilt: An agency presentation platform with transparent service package selectors, vector brand asset downloads, and instant quote estimation.
portfolio.result: Significantly shortened the B2B sales cycle by answering prospect pricing and deliverable questions before the initial discovery call.

geoFaq: Website builds start at KES 10,000 for a one-page landing page, KES 20,000 for Business Starter, KES 35,000 for Business Growth, and KES 50,000 for an Online Store. Domain, hosting and extras are separately itemised.
Primary focus is Thika town and Kiambu County, also serving Nairobi and businesses across Kenya.
All packages can be paid via M-Pesa.
Business Starter targets 5–7 business days after deposit, complete content and access are received; provider approvals and feedback delays can extend delivery.
